openrouter_attempt_shape.value: ("openrouter_attempts"."state" = 'pending' and "openrouter_attempts"."verifier_envelope" is not null and "openrouter_attempts"."candidate_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."result_epoch" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."first_link" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."failure" is null) or ("openrouter_attempts"."state" = 'exchanging' and "openrouter_attempts"."verifier_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."candidate_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."result_epoch" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."first_link" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."failure" is null) or ("openrouter_attempts"."state" = 'checking' and "openrouter_attempts"."verifier_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."candidate_envelope" is not null and "openrouter_attempts"."result_epoch" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."first_link" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."failure" is null) or ("openrouter_attempts"."state" = 'completed' and "openrouter_attempts"."verifier_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."candidate_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."result_epoch" is not null and "openrouter_attempts"."result_epoch" >= 1 and "openrouter_attempts"."first_link" is not null and "openrouter_attempts"."first_link" in (0,1) and "openrouter_attempts"."failure" is null) or ("openrouter_attempts"."state" = 'failed' and "openrouter_attempts"."verifier_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."candidate_envelope" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."result_epoch" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."first_link" is null and "openrouter_attempts"."failure" is not null and "openrouter_attempts"."failure" in ('OPENROUTER_EXPIRED','OPENROUTER_CONTEXT_CHANGED','OPENROUTER_EXCHANGE_UNKNOWN','OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_REJECTED','OPENROUTER_CANCELLED','OPENROUTER_CONNECTION_CHANGED'))

openrouter_connection_shape.name: openrouter_connection_shape
openrouter_connection_shape.value: ("openrouter_connections"."state" = 'unlinked' and "openrouter_connections"."credential_envelope" is null and "openrouter_connections"."key_expires_at" is null and "openrouter_connections"."provider_user_id" is null and "openrouter_connections"."linked_at" is null and "openrouter_connections"."last_used_at" is null) or ("openrouter_connections"."state" in ('linked','needs_relink') and "openrouter_connections"."credential_envelope" is not null and length("openrouter_connections"."credential_envelope") > 0 and "openrouter_connections"."linked_at" is not null and "openrouter_connections"."ever_linked_at" is not null and "openrouter_connections"."epoch" >= 1)

openrouter_models_ids.name: openrouter_models_ids
openrouter_models_ids.value: length("openrouter_model_settings"."text_model") between 1 and 255 and length("openrouter_model_settings"."image_model") between 1 and 255 and length("openrouter_model_settings"."audio_model") between 1 and 255

pdf_artifact_live.name: pdf_artifact_live
pdf_artifact_live.value: ("pdf_artifacts"."live_note_id" is not null and "pdf_artifacts"."live_note_id"="pdf_artifacts"."target_note_id") or ("pdf_artifacts"."state"='removed' and "pdf_artifacts"."live_note_id" is null)

pdf_artifact_storage.name: pdf_artifact_storage
pdf_artifact_storage.value: ("pdf_artifacts"."state"='removed' and "pdf_artifacts"."storage_key" is null and "pdf_artifacts"."file" is null and "pdf_artifacts"."reserved_bytes"=0) or ("pdf_artifacts"."state"!='removed' and "pdf_artifacts"."storage_key" is not null)

pdf_artifact_ready.name: pdf_artifact_ready
pdf_artifact_ready.value: "pdf_artifacts"."state"!='ready' or ("pdf_artifacts"."file" is not null and "pdf_artifacts"."published_at" is not null and "pdf_artifacts"."expires_at" is not null and "pdf_artifacts"."expires_at"="pdf_artifacts"."published_at"+86400000)

pdf_artifact_unpublished.name: pdf_artifact_unpublished
pdf_artifact_unpublished.value: "pdf_artifacts"."state"!='writing' or ("pdf_artifacts"."file" is null and "pdf_artifacts"."published_at" is null and "pdf_artifacts"."expires_at" is null)

pdf_artifact_expiry.name: pdf_artifact_expiry
pdf_artifact_expiry.value: ("pdf_artifacts"."published_at" is null and "pdf_artifacts"."expires_at" is null) or ("pdf_artifacts"."published_at" is not null and "pdf_artifacts"."expires_at" is not null and "pdf_artifacts"."expires_at"="pdf_artifacts"."published_at"+86400000)

pdf_computation_lease.name: pdf_computation_lease
pdf_computation_lease.value: ("pdf_computations"."state" in('queued','closed') and "pdf_computations"."lease_token" is null and "pdf_computations"."lease_until" is null) or ("pdf_computations"."state" in('running','stopping') and "pdf_computations"."lease_token" is not null and "pdf_computations"."lease_until" is not null)

pdf_computation_live.name: pdf_computation_live
pdf_computation_live.value: ("pdf_computations"."live_note_id" is not null and "pdf_computations"."live_note_id"="pdf_computations"."target_note_id") or ("pdf_computations"."state"='closed' and "pdf_computations"."workspace_removed"=1 and "pdf_computations"."live_note_id" is null)

pdf_delivery_owner.name: pdf_delivery_owner
pdf_delivery_owner.value: ("pdf_deliveries"."state" in('ready','closed') and "pdf_deliveries"."claim_token" is null and "pdf_deliveries"."runtime_id" is null) or ("pdf_deliveries"."state" in('sending','closing') and "pdf_deliveries"."claim_token" is not null and "pdf_deliveries"."runtime_id" is not null)

pdf_request_result.name: pdf_request_result
pdf_request_result.value: ("pdf_requests"."state"='succeeded' and "pdf_requests"."artifact_id" is not null and "pdf_requests"."failure" is null) or ("pdf_requests"."state"='failed' and "pdf_requests"."artifact_id" is null and "pdf_requests"."failure" is not null) or ("pdf_requests"."state" in('queued','running','cancelled') and "pdf_requests"."artifact_id" is null and "pdf_requests"."failure" is null)

pdf_request_live.name: pdf_request_live
pdf_request_live.value: ("pdf_requests"."live_note_id" is not null and "pdf_requests"."live_note_id"="pdf_requests"."target_note_id") or ("pdf_requests"."state" in('succeeded','failed','cancelled') and "pdf_requests"."live_note_id" is null)

pdf_request_compute.name: pdf_request_compute
pdf_request_compute.value: "pdf_requests"."state" not in('queued','running') or "pdf_requests"."compute_id" is not null

profile_icon_output.name: profile_icon_output
profile_icon_output.value: "account_profile_icons"."state" not in ('writing','ready') or ("account_profile_icons"."sha256" is not null and "account_profile_icons"."width" is not null and "account_profile_icons"."height" is not null and "account_profile_icons"."width">0 and "account_profile_icons"."height">0)

purge_manual_actor.name: purge_manual_actor
purge_manual_actor.value: ("note_purges"."cause"='manual' AND "note_purges"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "note_purges"."workspace_deletion_id" IS NULL) OR ("note_purges"."cause"='expired' AND "note_purges"."workspace_deletion_id" IS NULL) OR ("note_purges"."cause"='workspace-deletion' AND "note_purges"."account_id" IS NULL AND "note_purges"."workspace_deletion_id" IS NOT NULL AND "note_purges"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

reference_job_fields.name: reference_job_fields
reference_job_fields.value: ("reference_jobs"."state"='running' AND "reference_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "reference_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "reference_jobs"."failure" IS NULL) OR ("reference_jobs"."state"='failed' AND "reference_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."failure" IS NOT NULL) OR ("reference_jobs"."state" IN ('queued','succeeded','cancelled') AND "reference_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "reference_jobs"."failure" IS NULL)

workspace_deletion_state_fields.name: workspace_deletion_state_fields
workspace_deletion_state_fields.value: ("workspace_deletions"."state"='queued' AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_deletions"."state"='running' AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_deletions"."state"='succeeded' AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."lease_until" IS NULL AND "workspace_deletions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_profile_state.name: workspace_profile_state
workspace_profile_state.value: ("workspaces"."state"='active' AND "workspaces"."creator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."created_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("workspaces"."state"='deleted' AND "workspaces"."creator_id" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."name" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."description" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."created_at" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."icon_id" IS NULL)
